cohort: 2639 multi-ethnic women with varying degrees of hyperglycemia during pregnancy
finding: Women with late GDM were least likely to experience adverse pregnancy outcomes compared to women with early GDM, overt diabetes, or known T2DM during pregnancy.
mod_finding: Caesarean delivery rates were significantly different across the groups (late GDM: 32.7%, early GDM: 45.1%, overt diabetes: 39.4%, and T2DM: 53.5%, P < 0.001).
